whatif_rule_based_demo.method: One day's plan is replaced by an alternative; every other recorded request is replayed unchanged. A later recorded plan that becomes infeasible is rejected by the engine and that day runs the default plan. A gain is evidence of a local improvement, not of an optimal plan.
